$comment: TIF-98 leak guard allowlist (src/leak-guard/). Applies to TRACKED files only, never to produced outputs. 'accounts' are documented placeholder account names: a home path whose account segment is one of these is not a leak. 'files' skip whole leak classes in one file. Every entry needs a reason, and an entry that no longer suppresses anything fails the guard (stale). Do not add an entry to get a red guard green: fix the leak. Generic CI/sandbox accounts (user, runner, ubuntu, agent) are deliberately NOT account-level entries, because a real leak of a CI or cloud-sandbox checkout path uses exactly those names; they are file-scoped instead.

accounts.reason: The trial VM's own guest account (Windows C:\Users\myco, Linux /home/myco), created by agent/bootstrap and runtime/guest; never a host account.

Conventional placeholder account in src/dataset/hygiene.ts comments and handoff tests.
Windows' built-in shared profile C:\Users\Public (the SAI fixture drop folder); not a person's account.
